thread:
Sam: quick incident postmortem note: customer saw brief flapping during pin flips. Root cause: resolver accepted pin_epoch but enforcement happened immediately while pools were still finishing prepare. We need a small safety window plus better traces.
Izzy: agreed. two ergonomic asks: 1) a compact decision_trace that clients can surface in error pages; 2) a per-route sparklines metric in console showing recent "resolver switches" to help debug flapping.
Cheng: for schema additions propose fields: `pin_priority` (int), `enforce_after` (ISO timestamp), and `decision_trace_id` (uuid). Enforcement only applies after enforce_after or after quorum commit, whichever is later. Legacy pins map: pin_priority=10, enforce_after=immediate.
Marta: prefer `enforce_after` over implicit waits. Operators can set a short safety window (e.g., 30s) to allow pools to finish prepare. Also add `enforce_strategy` enum: `quorum`|`time`|`quorum_or_time`. Default `quorum_or_time`.
Sam: example client_pin snippet (as a string in the thread):
```json
{"client_pin":{"model":"m-stable","pin_priority":80,"pin_epoch":12,"enforce_after":"2026-04-07T15:00:30Z","enforce_strategy":"quorum_or_time","decision_trace_id":"9f8b7a6c-1234"}}
```
Izzy: decision_trace payload idea: small JSON returned in X-Resolver-Trace when debug on and also persisted in trace store. Example: `\{"trace_id\":\"9f8b7a6c-1234\",\"winner\":\"client_pin\",\"reason\":\"pin_enforced_after_quorum\",\"pin_priority\":80,\"pin_epoch\":12,\"enforce_ts\":\"2026-04-07T15:00:31Z\"\}`. Keep compact to avoid header bloat.
Cheng: sparklines metric: `resolver.switches.count` with rolling window (1m,5m,1h) and tags {tenant,route,winner}. Console shows tiny sparkline per-route and an alert rule if 1m switches > threshold. Helps detect flapping.
Marta: ops safety: add hysteresis TTL on pins: if a pin flips away from a tenant-model and then flips back within a short TTL, treat as same transition and suppress duplicate notifications. Add metric `pin.flap.suppressed`.
Sam: compatibility: Phase 1 accept new fields; Phase 2 emit X-Resolver-Trace and sparklines to console as opt-in; Phase 3 enable enforce_after behavior default (quorum_or_time) after 2 weeks.
Izzy: tests: add e2e where prepare acks are slow and ensure resolver defers enforcement until enforce_after or quorum. Add a chaos test with replica reorders.
Cheng: I'll implement schema + trace id plumbing. Marta: I'll add console sparklines and alert. Ops-bot: staging deploy queued: resolver-enforce-window -> staging. ETA ~10m. :rocket:
Sam: thanks. I'll write the RFC follow-up with schema, example traces, console mockups, and the flap-suppression heuristics. If staging shows regressions, post here.
